title: First surviving term preserved by the decoded restriction
statement: Let $f$ be a DNF formula on $n$ variables, viewed as an ordered list of terms, in which no term contains two distinct literals on the same variable. Fix restrictions $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$ such that $\sigma$ leaves free every variable that $\rho_0$ leaves free, and suppose that $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ is the first term of $f$, in list order, that is not killed by $\rho_0$. Let $\rho_{\mathrm{enc}}$ be the restriction obtained as the first component of the output of the Razborov encoding procedure applied to $f$ — with width parameter $w$ and the given fuel and path arguments — started from $\rho_0$ and $\sigma$, and let $\rho_{\mathrm{dec}}$ be any restriction that agrees with $\rho_0$ on every variable that $\rho_0$ fixes and with $\rho_{\mathrm{enc}}$ on every variable that $\rho_0$ leaves free. Then $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ is also the first term of $f$, in list order, that is not killed by $\rho_{\mathrm{dec}}$.
hypotheses_covered: No term of $f$ has two distinct literals on the same variable
$t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ is the first term of $f$ not killed by $\rho_0$
$\sigma$ leaves free every variable left free by $\rho_0$
$\rho_{\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with the encoder's output restriction on variables free under $\rho_0$
$\rho_{\mathrm{dec}}$ agrees with $\rho_0$ on variables fixed by $\rho_0$
caveat: Hypothesis hB is stated in terms of an external, undefined encoding function (razborovEncode.go), whose output restriction $\rho_{\mathrm{enc}}$ cannot be made fully self-contained without knowing what that procedure computes; the surrounding combinatorial content (first non-killed term preserved) is otherwise clear and faithfully rendered.
replaced:
For a DNF $f$ with no two literals in a term sharing a variable, suppose the encoder finds
$t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ as the first term not killed by $\rho_0$. Under the agreement
hypotheses relating $\rho_0$, $\sigma$, and the decoder restriction $\rho_{0,\mathrm{dec}}$
(agreeing with the encoder output on free variables and with $\rho_0$ on set variables),
the decoder restriction also finds $t_{\mathrm{clause}}$ as its first non-killed clause.
